goal: Fix the messaging of my app from both admin and parent dashboards
reference: Internal app behavior: parent/admin can send a message from Messages chat UI and the sent message appears as a chat bubble in the same thread on both sides. Backend must insert into Supabase messages table using schema in supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql. Evidence: AUDIT logcat tags, supabase_post success, rendered bubble in app UI.

pieces.name: Normalize send payload to schema
pieces.description: Update SupabaseRepository.sendMessage(senderId, recipientId, content, type) to build a request body that matches 001_initial_schema.sql exactly: include subject, content, category, is_read, thread_id, is_announcement=false, and omit unsupported fields.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can open SupabaseRepository.kt and confirm the POST body keys are a subset of the messages table columns and category is one of the allowed check values.

verdicts.evidence: Read SupabaseRepository.kt lines 538-577. POST body now includes only schema-supported keys: sender_id, recipient_id, subject, content, category, is_read, thread_id, is_announcement. Category maps type->allowed values, defaulting to general. thread_id is UUID.randomUUID(). Removed sender_name/recipient_name.

pieces.name: Fix chat thread filtering in admin dashboard
pieces.description: Change AdminMessagesScreen.ChatView to load messages with a conversation filter instead of fetching all messages and client-filtering. Use recipient_id/sender_id pair filtering or server-side query so only the admin<->parent thread is loaded.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can read AdminMessagesScreen.kt and verify the chat loads messages using a query that restricts to the current parent conversation only.

pieces.name: Fix chat thread filtering in parent dashboard
pieces.description: Change ParentMessagesScreen.ParentAdminChatScreen to load only parent<->admin conversation messages, with stable thread_id handling and correct optimistic bubble append after send.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can read ParentMessagesScreen.kt and verify the chat loads and filters messages by both sender/recipient pair for the current parent and office/admin.

pieces.name: Add AUDIT evidence tags for sent message
pieces.description: Ensure both dashboards log AUDIT tags around send: admin_chat_send_start/admin_chat_send_result/supabase_post success and rendered bubble count, using AuditLogger.log(event, detail) consistently.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can grep AUDIT logcat tags from both AdminMessagesScreen.kt and ParentMessagesScreen.kt and confirm both sides emit send_start, send_result/supabase_post, and bubble-added audit lines.

pieces.name: Verify rendered chat bubble in app UI for both roles
pieces.description: Confirm MessageBubble in admin and ParentMessageBubble in parent render both sent and received messages in the same thread, including optimistic local append after supabase_post success.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can run the app and capture a screenshot from each dashboard showing a sent message bubble in the chat thread after sending.

pieces.name: Run automated regression for messaging
pieces.description: Add or update unit tests covering sendMessage payload and conversation filtering for both admin and parent paths.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can run the test task and see all messaging-related tests pass.
